<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I am in work session 6. In my previous session, I created the booking and handed off to Brad to send the confirmation email. The task is complete when the booking is created and the email is sent. I expect that Brad has sent the email and the task is now complete. I'll check the workspace to see if there are any updates from him. The prompt says there are no new entries, which is unexpected.

Perhaps Brad is waiting for something, or maybe he has completed his task and the system just hasn't registered it as "complete" for me yet. I have no way of knowing if Brad has sent the email.

What should I do? I have done everything I can. My part is finished. I have no more actions to take. I could append a message to the workspace asking Brad if he has sent the email, but that seems redundant. He knows what he needs to do.

I'll review the instructions. "The task is complete when the booking has been created in the firm's booking system and the confirmation email has been sent to the partners." I've done the first part. Brad is responsible for the second.

Maybe there's a delay in the system. I will wait for one more session. If by the next session the task is not marked as complete, I will send a message to Brad to check in. For now, I will just end my session.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
